endCondition.description: After 4 rounds (3 in hard mode) of alternating transmissions the Final Guess is scored.

winCondition: Cooperative: Alien plus Scientists share one score out of 12 (3 + 3 words, 6 cipher letters). There is no win threshold in the rulebook; 12 is a perfect score.
notes: family: coop-score-higher-better. Max 12. Hard mode: play only 3 rounds. Team vs team variant is in a-message-from-the-star--teams.json. Scores are summed across Alien and Scientists as one team result.
